We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list). Need to choose one that can be further processed with next template 1914389, then 1914390, then 149040, then 1914391.

We need to construct JSON route: root molecule target, child reaction with template 29646, children are precursor molecules (SMILES). Then each precursor may have further reaction nodes.

We need to find a chain of 5 steps, not branching? At least 5 reactions total. Use templates in order. So we need a linear sequence: apply 29646 to target -> get intermediate A. Then apply 1914389 to A -> get B. Then 1914390 to B -> get C. Then 149040 to C -> get D. Then 1914391 to D -> get final precursors (starting materials). Ensure each application succeeds (non-empty result). We need to find appropriate SMILES that work.

We have some results: applying 29646 gave three possible precursors:

Result string: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO',))"

So three precursors: 
1) with two silyl groups? Actually first has CO[Si] and O[Si] both.
2) second: no silyl? Actually second lacks silyl on CO? It is "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO"
3) third: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO"

We need to apply 1914389 next. We tried applying 1914389 to some of these and got results for some.

We applied 1914389 to the first (with two silyl) got result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),)". So it gave two precursors: one is a molecule with silyl still, and the other is an ester? Actually second is "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". That's a different fragment.

We need a linear route; maybe choose the first precursor from 1914389 that still contains the core ring and silyl, then apply 1914390 to that.

We attempted 1914390 on "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C" and got empty result. So that path fails.

We also tried 1914390 on "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC" and got empty.

Thus need different precursor from 1914389 that works with 1914390.

We also applied 1914389 to other precursors: to "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO" got result "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),)". So similar.

Thus 1914389 seems to produce same two fragments.

Maybe we need to choose the fragment "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO" as intermediate for next step 1914390.

Let's try applying 1914390 to that.
